description: This file defines the EmployeeContactDetailsController class, a controller responsible for managing the contact details view of an employee within the OrangeHRM system. It prepares data and permissions for rendering employee contact information, including country list and employee number.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsController
classes.description: Controller for handling the employee contact details view, extending base view controller, managing component setup and permissions for employee contact data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares contact details component with employee data and permissions before rendering the view.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability permission checks related to contact details.
